sources.name: Darius Cike
sources.quote: To be honest, my work in Quantum Computing doesn't directly relate to my decision to move to West Oakland. I've been drawn to the area's industrial character and the energy of the community. As a researcher, I'm often consumed by my work, but living here gives me a different kind of stimulation. I've enjoyed checking out local events like First Friday galleries, and it's nice to be around people who aren't all in the tech space. My work is pretty isolating, so it's good to have a change of pace.

sources.name: Henry Rivas
sources.quote: As a Starting Pitcher for the Oakland A's, my daily life in West Oakland is pretty hectic. I'm always on the go, whether it's heading to the stadium or getting back to my family. The A's are a big part of my life, and I plan my days around the games. When I'm not pitching, I'm thinking about the next start or recovering from the last one. It's not easy, but it's worth it when I see the kids looking up to me like I'm some kinda hero.

sources.quote: I haven't seen Lena Cross's new home, but I did hear they moved into a place on Piedmont Ave. I don't know much about it, though.

approvedQuotes.text: To be honest, my work in Quantum Computing doesn't directly relate to my decision to move to West Oakland. I've been drawn to the area's industrial character and the energy of the community. As a researcher, I'm often consumed by my work, but living here gives me a different kind of stimulation. I've enjoyed checking out local events like First Friday galleries, and it's nice to be around people who aren't all in the tech space. My work is pretty isolating, so it's good to have a change of pace.

As a Starting Pitcher for the Oakland A's, my daily life in West Oakland is pretty hectic. I'm always on the go, whether it's heading to the stadium or getting back to my family. The A's are a big part of my life, and I plan my days around the games. When I'm not pitching, I'm thinking about the next start or recovering from the last one. It's not easy, but it's worth it when I see the kids looking up to me like I'm some kinda hero.
I haven't seen Lena Cross's new home, but I did hear they moved into a place on Piedmont Ave. I don't know much about it, though.
